en_US.website_article: A public HECTON-8 custody trail can split without becoming false. The object may sit in one drawer, the office record may name another desk, the public summary may carry a claimant-safe cover line, and a legal hold may freeze the packet under a fourth authority. The archive calls this custody divergence. It is not a verdict. It is a warning that the same packet moved through different rules. Object custody begins with the thing that can still be touched: seal, plate, bag, crate, sample sleeve, damaged tag, or stamped casing. Office custody names the desk that filed, stored, copied, or forwarded the record. Claimant-safe custody removes or softens a public name so the archive can show a summary without exposing a protected party. Legal custody stops movement under a hold, quarantine review, or dispute flag. These lanes can agree. On HECTON-8 evidence, they often do not. When they diverge, the public archive keeps all lanes visible. A clean office label does not erase a salt-stained object seal. A claimant-safe line does not prove who owned the packet. A legal hold does not reveal the final receiver. Read the lanes separately before building a public relation edge or evidence caption.
en_US.wiki_article: Custody divergence is the condition where one evidence packet carries separate custody lanes: object custody, office custody, claimant-safe custody, and legal custody. Each lane answers a different question. Object custody asks where the physical item went. Office custody asks which desk handled the record. Claimant-safe custody asks what can be shown without exposing a protected claimant. Legal custody asks which hold prevented movement. Divergence is handling evidence, not final ownership.
en_US.pda_codex: Archive rule: do not merge custody lanes. Object custody follows the seal and damage. Office custody follows the desk stamp. Claimant-safe custody follows the public-safe wording. Legal custody follows the hold tag. If the lanes disagree, keep the split until a witness hash, relay timestamp, or receipt body proves which lane carried the route.
en_US.scanner_entry: Custody divergence detected. Object mark, office stamp, claimant-safe line, and legal hold do not resolve to one lane. Confidence: partial. Required next evidence: witness hash, relay timestamp, receipt body, or custody sequence.
en_US.terminal_note: PUBLIC ARCHIVE CUSTODY DIVERGENCE Object custody: physical item. Office custody: filing desk. Claimant-safe custody: public-safe summary. Legal custody: hold or dispute authority. Do not collapse lanes into final receiver.
en_US.evidence_caption: Custody divergence card. The object seal, office stamp, claimant-safe line, and legal hold describe different custody lanes; none proves final receiver by itself.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Custody divergence language may appear early. Final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal result, route branch, and source admission stay masked until later proof gates.

de_DE.website_article: Eine öffentliche Verwahrungsspur kann in Objektverwahrung, Amtsverwahrung, claimant-safe Verwahrung und rechtliche Verwahrung aufgeteilt sein. Objektverwahrung folgt dem physischen Siegel oder Tag. Amtsverwahrung folgt dem Schreibtisch, der den Datensatz abgelegt hat. Claimant-safe Verwahrung schützt, was die öffentliche Zusammenfassung nennen darf. Rechtliche Verwahrung friert Bewegung unter einem Hold ein. Halte die Spuren getrennt, bis Zeugenhash, Relaiszeit oder Belegkörper zeigt, welche Spur die Route trug.

es_ES.website_article: Una pista pública de custodia puede dividirse en custodia del objeto, custodia de oficina, custodia segura para reclamante y custodia legal. La custodia del objeto sigue el sello o la etiqueta física. La custodia de oficina sigue la mesa que archivó el registro. La custodia segura para reclamante protege lo que el resumen público puede nombrar. La custodia legal congela el movimiento bajo una retención. Mantén las pistas separadas hasta que hash testigo, tiempo de relevo o cuerpo del recibo prueben qué pista llevó la ruta.

fr_FR.website_article: Une trace publique de garde peut se diviser entre garde de l'objet, garde de bureau, garde sûre pour réclamant et garde légale. La garde de l'objet suit le sceau ou l'étiquette physique. La garde de bureau suit le service qui a classé le dossier. La garde sûre pour réclamant protège ce que le résumé public peut nommer. La garde légale fige le mouvement sous retenue. Gardez les pistes séparées jusqu'à ce que le hash témoin, l'heure de relais ou le corps du reçu prouve quelle piste portait la route.

ko_KR.website_article: 공개 보관 추적은 물체 보관, 사무실 보관, 청구인 보호 보관, 법적 보관으로 갈라질 수 있다. 물체 보관은 물리적 봉인이나 태그를 따른다. 사무실 보관은 기록을 접수한 책상을 따른다. 청구인 보호 보관은 공개 요약이 이름 붙일 수 있는 범위를 보호한다. 법적 보관은 보류 아래 이동을 멈춘다. 증인 해시, 중계 시각, 또는 영수증 본문이 어느 선이 경로를 운반했는지 입증할 때까지 선들을 분리해 둔다.

pt_BR.website_article: Uma trilha pública de custódia pode se dividir em custódia do objeto, custódia de escritório, custódia segura para reclamante e custódia legal. A custódia do objeto segue o selo ou a etiqueta física. A custódia de escritório segue a mesa que arquivou o registro. A custódia segura para reclamante protege o que o resumo público pode nomear. A custódia legal congela movimento sob retenção. Mantenha as linhas separadas até que hash de testemunha, horário de relé ou corpo do recibo prove qual linha carregou a rota.

en_US.website_article: Hecton-8 scanner confidence drops when the instrument sees more than one story attached to the same object. A label may name a receiver. A stamped plate may name an older office. A witness hash may repeat under a different category. A terminal receipt may carry the old drawer route under a safer header. A route alias may show that the object moved before the archive learned its public name. The downgrade is not a failure message. It is a custody warning. The scanner keeps the conflict visible so a clean label cannot erase a cracked seal, salt-bloomed tag, scorched adhesive, receipt body, or repeated hash. Public readers may see "partial confidence." Field users read it as: do not throw away the dirty mark because the neat line is easier to file.
en_US.wiki_article: Scanner confidence downgrade reason: a qualified scanner note applied when evidence fields conflict. Common downgrade causes include label/object mismatch, object mark/receipt mismatch, witness hash under multiple labels, route alias conflict, and terminal receipt rewrite. The note does not decide final custody. It preserves the conflict until another evidence channel explains which field changed.
en_US.pda_codex: Scanner rule: partial confidence means the object is still useful. If the label, physical mark, witness hash, terminal receipt, or route alias disagree, keep every field. A clean name tells you how someone filed the object. A damaged mark may tell you where it moved before that name appeared.
en_US.scanner_entry: Confidence downgraded. Label, object mark, witness hash, receipt echo, or route alias conflict detected. Result: partial. Required next evidence: matching mark, receipt body, repeated hash, or alias trail.
en_US.terminal_note: SCANNER CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADE Cause: evidence fields disagree. Do not promote label over object mark. Do not discard receipt body, witness hash, or route alias. Action: preserve partial confidence until conflict source is resolved by another evidence channel.
en_US.evidence_caption: Partial-confidence scan. The scanner kept a label conflict visible because the object mark, witness hash, receipt echo, or route alias did not agree with the clean field.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Confidence downgrade language may appear early. Final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal result, route branch, and source admission stay masked behind later evidence gates.
en_US.title: Scanner Confidence Downgrade Reason

es_ES.website_article: La rebaja de confianza significa que el escáner encontró un conflicto, no que la evidencia sea débil. Si una etiqueta, marca del objeto, hash de testigo, recibo de terminal o alias de ruta discrepa, conserva todos los campos y marca el resultado como parcial. Un nombre limpio dice cómo alguien archivó el objeto. La marca dañada puede decir por dónde se movió antes de que ese nombre fuera seguro.

en_US.website_article: A PDA review prompt is not a conclusion. It appears when one evidence family has too many clean labels and too many damaged edges: an object mark that survived handling, a custody line that diverges from the public category, a scanner downgrade, a terminal receipt rewritten after the packet moved, a relation edge to another record, or a claimant-safe phrase that removes a name without removing the wound. Public archive editors treat the prompt as a hold. Marauder notes treat it as a warning. The PDA can ask the reader to review the family, but it cannot name the final receiver or decide who the language protected. The object still has to be read first.
en_US.wiki_article: PDA evidence-family review prompt: a neutral prompt shown when related records carry unresolved conflict. Common triggers include object mark, custody divergence, scanner downgrade, terminal receipt rewrite, relation edge, and claimant-safe language. The prompt asks for review only. It is not a verdict, source admission, final receiver label, protected-claimant label, route branch, or legal result.
